about: A genuine request written as a label: 'Required: current CV and two references', in a message long enough that it is not read as a short list. Synthetic.
subject: March dates at Wrenfield
body:
Hi Dr. Testa,

Thanks for confirming the March dates at Wrenfield Example Regional. The medical staff office is assembling your application and the committee meets on the 20th.

Required: current CV and two references

Once those are in, your file goes straight to the committee.

Thanks,
Jordan Vale
Medical Staff Coordinator
Wrenfield Example Regional
(701) 555-0133
